flag_vocabulary.verified: passed pre-registered gates with registry entries
flag_vocabulary.allow_backtest: may be used in backtest datasets
flag_vocabulary.allow_final_probabilities: may be the probability source of record

Market_Plus_External_Signal_Candidate.implemented: partial (signal status management only; signals never modify probabilities)

other_markets.note: must not pretend verified; unregistered fields in frozen 2A/2B remain UNKNOWN

dimension_c_data_states.gate: dq_namespace==forward AND dq_status==time_safe AND retrieved_at<kickoff_utc AND dq_pass
dimension_c_data_states.action: candidate signal record only, no probability change

dimension_d_output_states.VALID: baseline method hit, time-safe, complete input; real probabilities
dimension_d_output_states.CONDITIONAL: fallback chain used or timestamps unknown; real probabilities + downgrade note
dimension_d_output_states.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: no verified method constructible; probabilities null (never fabricated)
dimension_d_output_states.UNKNOWN: input present but semantics unclear; null or baseline-only
dimension_d_output_states.STOP: frozen fingerprint drift or leakage detected; probabilities null + fault details

dimension_e_evidence_levels.calibration_mapping: Evidence (CLOSED; never layered onto production predictions)
dimension_e_evidence_levels.understat_forward_xg_value: Hypothesis (gates not evaluated; time_safe=0 as of 2026-09-13)

invariants: only Market Baseline M4/O2 may output final probabilities, always with provenance (books, devig method, shin z, timestamps, missing fields)
external signals may only change status fields, never probability fields, until all increment gates pass with pre-registered authorization
TIME_SAFE_VALIDATED may only be granted via a validated-signal registry file (none exists); no hardcoding
any fallback (M4->M2->single-book, O2->O4->single-book) is recorded and downgrades to CONDITIONAL
all missing inputs map to INSUFFICIENT_DATA/UNKNOWN with null probabilities; no random/static/default probabilities
leakage or fingerprint drift triggers STOP, report-only
